# Tagvico

> Tagvico is an open-source, self-hosted companion for Paperless-ngx: chat across the archive with sources, approvals before any change, a Needs you list, household members, and review-first filing.

## Product facts

- Category: Paperless-ngx document automation and research
- Version: 3.5
- Deployment: self-hosted with Docker (image on GHCR)
- License: MIT
- Source of truth: Paperless-ngx remains the document archive
- Write boundary: the Companion's changes need approval from an owner or adult; metadata filing starts in review mode
- Model options: ChatGPT plan (Sign in with ChatGPT), OpenAI, OpenRouter, local Ollama, and other compatible providers
- Channels: Telegram and Discord
